import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
st_francis = ee.Geometry.Point([-101.8, 39.77])  # St. Francis, Kansas
death_valley = ee.Geometry.Point([-116.82, 36.51])  # Death Valley, California
date = '2025-06-24'

# 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS LST (Terra)
def mask_lst_qa(image):
    qa = image.select('QC_Day')
    # Bits 0-1: LST quality (00 = good)
    good_quality = qa.bitwiseAnd(3).eq(0)
    return image.updateMask(good_quality)

col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD11A1') \
    .filterDate(date, ee.Date(date).advance(1, 'day')) \
    .map(mask_lst_qa)

print(f"Total images found for {date}: {col.size().getInfo()}")

if col.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print(f"No MODIS data for {date}. Trying Aqua (MYD11A1)...")
    col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MYD11A1') \
        .filterDate(date, ee.Date(date).advance(1, 'day')) \
        .map(mask_lst_qa)
    print(f"Aqua images: {col.size().getInfo()}")
    
if col.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("No data available for either location.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # 3. Get LST image and convert Kelvin to Celsius
    img = col.first()
    lst_day = img.select('LST_Day_1km').multiply(0.02).subtract(273.15)  # K to C
    
    # 4. Calculate max temperature for each location
    sf_stats = lst_day.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.max().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', True),
        geometry=st_francis,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).getInfo()
    
    dv_stats = lst_day.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.max().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', True),
        geometry=death_valley,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).getInfo()
    
    sf_max = sf_stats.get('LST_Day_1km_max')
    sf_count = sf_stats.get('LST_Day_1km_count')
    dv_max = dv_stats.get('LST_Day_1km_max')
    dv_count = dv_stats.get('LST_Day_1km_count')
    
    print(f"St. Francis: Max={sf_max}C, Pixels={sf_count}")
    print(f"Death Valley: Max={dv_max}C, Pixels={dv_count}")
    
    # 5. Validation & Final Answer
    if sf_count == 0 or dv_count == 0:
        print("No valid pixels after masking.")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    elif sf_max is None or dv_max is None:
        print("Calculation failed - invalid results.")
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    elif sf_max < -50 or sf_max > 70 or dv_max < -50 or dv_max > 70:
        print("Temperature values out of realistic range.")
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    elif sf_max > dv_max:
        print(f"St. Francis ({sf_max:.1f}C) > Death Valley ({dv_max:.1f}C)")
        print("<answer>A</answer>")
    else:
        print(f"St. Francis ({sf_max:.1f}C) <= Death Valley ({dv_max:.1f}C)")
        print("<answer>B</answer>")

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
st_francis = ee.Geometry.Point([-101.8, 39.77]).buffer(5000)  # 5km buffer
death_valley = ee.Geometry.Point([-116.82, 36.51]).buffer(5000)  # 5km buffer
date = '2025-06-24'

# 2. More lenient QA mask - accept LST quality 0,1,2 (only reject 3=not produced)
def mask_lst_qa(image):
    qa = image.select('QC_Day')
    # Bits 0-1: LST quality (00=good, 01=other, 10=TBD, 11=not produced)
    # Accept 0, 1, 2 (reject only 3)
    valid_quality = qa.bitwiseAnd(3).lt(3)
    return image.updateMask(valid_quality)

# 3. Try both Terra and Aqua to get peak temperature
def get_max_temp(geometry, location_name):
    # Terra (morning pass)
    terra_col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD11A1') \
        .filterDate(date, ee.Date(date).advance(1, 'day')) \
        .map(mask_lst_qa)
    
    # Aqua (afternoon pass)
    aqua_col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MYD11A1') \
        .filterDate(date, ee.Date(date).advance(1, 'day')) \
        .map(mask_lst_qa)
    
    # Merge both collections
    combined = terra_col.merge(aqua_col)
    
    print(f"{location_name}: Terra={terra_col.size().getInfo()}, Aqua={aqua_col.size().getInfo()}")
    
    if combined.size().getInfo() == 0:
        return None, 0
    
    # Get maximum LST across all images
    lst_day = combined.select('LST_Day_1km').max().multiply(0.02).subtract(273.15)
    
    stats = lst_day.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.max().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', True),
        geometry=geometry,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).getInfo()
    
    max_temp = stats.get('LST_Day_1km_max')
    count = stats.get('LST_Day_1km_count')
    
    return max_temp, count

# 4. Calculate for both locations
sf_max, sf_count = get_max_temp(st_francis, "St. Francis")
dv_max, dv_count = get_max_temp(death_valley, "Death Valley")

print(f"St. Francis: Max={sf_max}°C, Pixels={sf_count}")
print(f"Death Valley: Max={dv_max}°C, Pixels={dv_count}")

# 5. Validation & Final Answer
if sf_count == 0 and dv_count == 0:
    print("No valid pixels for either location.")
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
elif sf_count == 0 or dv_count == 0:
    print("One location has no valid data.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
elif sf_max is None or dv_max is None:
    print("Calculation failed - invalid results.")
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
elif sf_max < -50 or sf_max > 70 or dv_max < -50 or dv_max > 70:
    print("Temperature values out of realistic range.")
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
elif sf_max > dv_max:
    print(f"St. Francis peak ({sf_max:.1f}°C) > Death Valley ({dv_max:.1f}°C)")
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print(f"St. Francis peak ({sf_max:.1f}°C) <= Death Valley ({dv_max:.1f}°C)")
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
